behavior: Forages mainly on the ground, walking or running through low vegetation for seeds and invertebrates; flight is typically quick and low. Males sing from exposed low perches and perform fluttering territorial and courtship displays.
field_marks: Small conical bill and dark eye
Yellow patch in front of the eye
White underparts with crisp dark streaks
Short, slightly notched tail and pinkish legs
habitat: Open habitats with low vegetation, including grasslands, meadows, pastures, cultivated fields, grassy roadsides, sedge wetlands, salt marshes, estuaries, dunes, shores, and tundra.
